quiz: Where does the word “lean” applied to production come from?
An MIT study of the automotive industry
The term was adopted by the MIT program team behind The Machine That Changed the World (1990).
What is the order of the five lean principles?
Value, value stream, flow, pull, perfection
You start from value for the customer before organizing flow, otherwise you optimize useless activities.
Who must define value according to Womack and Jones?
Value only makes sense for the end customer, for a specific product, at a specific price and time.
What does the soda can example illustrate?
A journey of several hundred days for a few hours of real processing
Each link is efficient, but the whole stream is made of waiting and inventory.
The pace at which the customer buys
Available time divided by demand: the metronome of flow.
They are large machines that impose batches and make products come to them
They prefer simple, flexible machines placed in flow cells.
What is the difference between kaizen and kaikaku?
Kaizen is gradual, kaikaku is radical improvement
Kaikaku makes the big leap, then kaizen improves every day.
What do the authors recommend about jobs?
Lay people off with each productivity gain
Guarantee that no one will lose their job because of improvements
Without this guarantee, employees have no reason to contribute to improvements.
